Upstream launcher owns setup and self-update. macOS source experiment has no launcher/download and races/save reload/controllers unvalidated; preserve independent implementation identity. Upstream platforms: Windows installer; Linux Flatpak/tar.gz. macOS is a source experiment without launcher/download. Exact PC architecture needs selected-package documentation. Original data: Xbox 360 Forza Horizon 2012 own disc/GOD/extracted game; TU4 optional for Rally/1000 Club.
